source_selection.basis: Public defconfig, header, DT and provider selection; not a newly observed runtime call trace.
source_selection.planet_defconfig: OF, common clocks and MT6797 common-clock provider enabled; MTK_CLKMGR disabled; MTK watchdog enabled.
source_selection.namespace_boundary: Vendor clock-binding ID 2 and provider-internal ID 1 are not upstream power-domain IDs.
source_selection.gemian_corroboration: The pinned provider agrees on CONN control/status/protection and island order; its mt6797.dts maps the conn clock to SCP_SYS_CONN. No matching common MT6797 WMT implementation was established from that pin.

spm.sram_basis: Selected CCF CONN routine has no SRAM transition; existing upstream fields accept zero masks. Legacy zero-mask helpers still access the control register.

infracfg.inactive_branch_basis: CONSYS_PWR_ON_OFF_API_AVAILABLE is 1; the alternative direct-register branch and its CONSYS_PROT_MASK are not the selected CCF contract.
infracfg.offset_basis: WMT's TOPCKGEN-relative view and the INFRACFG-relative view refer to the same public register locations; do not create competing mappings.

external_cpu_reset.ownership: Separate reset-provider prerequisite; the power-domain data fields do not assert this reset.

representation.existing_domain_ids: 0 through 11; none names CONN. Append a new binding ID rather than reusing GPU IDs.
representation.optional_supply: One domain-named regulator; absence is accepted and does not block activation.
representation.basic_clocks: Up to three predefined clock IDs enabled before island power-on; this is not the outer WMT preparation sequence.
representation.missing_operation: Per-domain suppression of probe-time power-on with explicit initial-state admission in the currently bound legacy MT6797 provider.

probe_admission.existing_legacy_behavior: Provider registration invokes power_on for every listed domain before any consumer request. A disabled consumer or missing optional supply does not prevent it. Power-on failure warns and registration continues.
probe_admission.initial_both_status_bits_clear: May register the domain as off without calling either power callback; this does not authorize a later transition or prove all preparation complete.
probe_admission.initial_both_status_bits_set: Must not blindly adopt the on-state or declare it off; resource ownership and handoff remain unproved.
probe_admission.initial_status_bits_mixed: Refuse admission; do not normalize the hardware with a power callback.

existing_newer_driver_mechanism.behavior: Skips initial power_on, warns if status says on, then initializes genpd as off.
existing_newer_driver_mechanism.limitation: Precedent for suppressing initial activation, not a complete firmware-on adoption or mixed-state refusal implementation.

source_sequences.vendor_ccf_preamble: Write SPM register-control enable/key at offset 0x0000 before either transition.
source_sequences.off_order_difference: Vendor CCF disables the clock before asserting SPM reset; legacy upstream asserts reset first. Equivalence is unproved.
source_sequences.polling_boundary: Legacy upstream power/SRAM polling uses nominal one-second limits; protection has its own bounded ACK poll. These do not provide complete transaction rollback.

unresolved_ownership_and_recovery.spm_global_register_control: Vendor writes 0x0b160001 at SPM offset 0x0000. Neither audited upstream power-domain driver supplies this operation; ownership, necessity on the selected baseline and safe restoration remain unproved.
unresolved_ownership_and_recovery.outer_preparation: VCN rails, the CONN-to-AP sleep mask, external CPU reset and subsequent WMT preparation are outside island domain data and need coordinated owners.
unresolved_ownership_and_recovery.optional_ahb_clock_branch: The selected WMT header sets CONSYS_AHB_CLK_MAGEMENT to 0; do not infer that inactive branch as a mandatory clock dependency.
unresolved_ownership_and_recovery.legacy_power_on_failure: Clocks and optional supply are disabled, but power/reset/isolation/protection registers are not fully restored.
unresolved_ownership_and_recovery.legacy_power_off_failure: Returns an error without reconstructing the prior domain state.
unresolved_ownership_and_recovery.decision: No bare CONN domain-data patch or active candidate. Resolve provider admission, outer prerequisites, ordering and failure ownership before enabling a consumer.
